svg.title: Conceptual unnormalized phase separation
svg.desc: Analytical toy only: P=5, M=2, phi=2pi*p/5, d=3+cos(phi)+0.5sin(phi). Rows 1, cos(phi), sin(phi) produce B0=15, E1=2.5, O1=1.25. a.u. means arbitrary units. This real-valued toy is not pipeline output; actual quadratures are complex. The stored x-Nyquist column is excluded.
